description: This PHP script acts as a client to interact with the TestLink API, specifically to retrieve test cases for given test suites. It sets up parameters, demonstrates usage with different test suites, and outputs results.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used for making XML-RPC client calls to the server, instantiated with the server URL.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function that executes the test call to the API with specified method and parameters.
